name: context-viz
notes: The gauge surface: a filled/empty block meter plus rate-limit rows plus a cost row, all driven by live counters. The meter's fill level is ENV-dependent (tokens used) but the LABEL rows are not, which is why the needles are the labels. NOTE: /context is a TOGGLE — a scenario that presses it twice ends with the overlay closed, so never append a second /context to `keys`.
